gates.title: Firebase Analytics Explore verification
doneWhen: A temporary fixed-enum-only Explore is created under explicit approval.
Android-only safe event rows are verified and the temporary Explore is removed.

gates.title: Production API migration and deploy
doneWhen: C98 preflight passes with count-only output on the approved production target.
The controlled migration and API deploy finish once, then C98 postdeploy and Android API smokes pass.

gates.title: Real mutation interruption recovery
doneWhen: Approved disposable PRN and inventory operations are interrupted after request transmission.
Refresh and same-intent retry prove one server effect without automatic replay or ambiguous UI success.

gates.title: Production App Links and Android FCM
doneWhen: The canonical assetlinks endpoint and Play-installed domain verification pass with the app-signing certificate.
Android token registration and FC-002 through FC-010 delivery, privacy, routing and cleanup rows pass.
gates.backlogTitle: Production App Links and Android FCM

gates.title: Release-owner signing and exact AAB handoff
doneWhen: The owner-managed upload key and independent Play certificate identities pass every fail-closed signing gate.
The exact clean-commit AAB, ledger and SHA256SUMS three-file handoff is retained unchanged.
gates.backlogTitle: Release-owner signing and exact AAB handoff

gates.title: Play Internal install and update verification
doneWhen: The exact handoff AAB is processed and installed from Play Internal with Play app signing.
Fresh install, prior-version update, App Links, sessions, notifications and package identity pass on the exact artifact.
gates.backlogTitle: Play Internal install and update verification

gates.title: Old-supported and Google-reference physical devices
doneWhen: The required API 26-28 physical target passes its applicable release matrix rows.
A current Google-reference physical target passes its applicable exact-Play-artifact rows.

gates.title: Assisted spoken TalkBack traversal
doneWhen: One-finger focus, spoken order, double-tap activation and two-finger scrolling pass across both role flows.
No hidden, clipped, duplicate, blank or sensitive announcement remains on the exact Play artifact.

gates.title: Play Console Data safety and Health declarations
doneWhen: Current SDK disclosures and the exact signed artifact are reconciled with the worksheet.
Data safety, Health apps, account deletion and store declarations are submitted and recorded.
gates.backlogTitle: Play Console Data safety and Health declarations

gates.title: Closed test, final rebaseline and main merge
doneWhen: Closed testing, crash and ANR review complete with no unresolved P0 or P1 defect.
Latest main is rebaselined, every release gate passes and the reviewed zero-iOS-drift merge is explicitly approved.
gates.backlogTitle: Closed test, final rebaseline and main merge
